normalization.euclideanAction: integral [f wedge star f/(2 e^2) + dsigma wedge star dsigma/2 + (v+sigma)^2(dtheta-3a) wedge star(dtheta-3a)/2 + lambda(|s|^2-v^2/2)^2]
normalization.firstOrderPhaseAction: integral [H wedge star H/(8 pi^2 v^2) + i H wedge(dtheta-3a)/(2 pi)]
normalization.dualAction: integral [db wedge star db/(8 pi^2 v^2) + i 3 b wedge da/(2 pi)] plus Maxwell and irrelevant corrections

compactPeriods.integralDa: 2 pi integers away from Higgs vortices

spectrumFormulas.readerCycleEnergySquared: M_reader^2 + 4 sin^2((2 pi n + 2 pi q h/3)/(2N))

vortexAndDefect.higgsVortex: an oriented codimension-two worldsheet W2 in four dimensions with dd theta=2 pi n delta_2(W2)
vortexAndDefect.flux: integral_linking_disk da = -2 pi n/3 in the stated sign convention
vortexAndDefect.orbifoldDefect: a codimension-one fixed plane Sigma3 of S1/Z2, not the vortex worldsheet
vortexAndDefect.intersection: gamma1=W2 intersect Sigma3 is a worldline; if W2 carries the interval tangent, integral_W2 b reduces to integral_gamma1 c
vortexAndDefect.orientation: n=+1 and n=-1 have equal energy in the CP-even action and conjugate mutual phases; the action does not choose one

orbifold.reducedAction: i 3 integral_Sigma3 c wedge da/(2 pi)
orbifold.normalizationRule: c is the interval-integrated compact one-form, so the integer level is not multiplied by interval length

boundaryVariation.bulk: delta S_BF = i3/(2pi) integral_M [delta b wedge da - db wedge delta a]
boundaryVariation.boundary: i3/(2pi) integral_boundaryM pullback(b) wedge delta pullback(a)
boundaryVariation.twoFormGaugeBoundary: delta_Lambda S_BF=i3/(2pi) integral_boundaryM pullback(Lambda) wedge da
boundaryVariation.orbifoldResolution: b_mu_nu and tangential Lambda_mu are odd and vanish on fixed planes, so both boundary terms vanish
boundaryVariation.maxwellBoundary: variation adds integral_boundary delta a_i n_mu f^{mu i}/e^2
boundaryVariation.readerBoundaryEquation: for dynamical boundary a_i, n_mu f^{mu i}/e^2 + j_reader^i = 0, or the corresponding jump equation in the doubled/folded picture
boundaryVariation.qualification: orbifold parity closes the BF boundary term but does not by itself solve the Maxwell-plus-reader boundary equation
otherAllowedPolarizations: add the boundary Legendre term and fix the dual polarization

reader.field: complex scalar chi localized on Sigma3
coexistenceConditions: lambda_chi>0 and chi has no condensate
the reader gap stays above the experiment/probe energy
no anomaly-forced or boundary-condition-forced charged zero mode exists
virtual winding splittings are treated as finite-size non-topological corrections
reader.condensationConsequence: a charge-one condensate breaks the residual Z3 completely and destroys the claimed BF topological phase

allChargedDefectMatterGappedDefinition.formula: Delta_ch = inf spectrum(H_Sigma restricted to residual charges 1 or 2 mod 3) > 0 uniformly over admitted holonomy sectors
requires: positive quadratic spectrum after constraints and boundary conditions
no charged Goldstone or edge zero mode
no uncancelled localized anomaly requiring gapless charged matter
magnetic vortex excitations have positive tension/gap
probe energies and temperatures are below Delta_ch, radial/vector gaps and the first KK gap
allChargedDefectMatterGappedDefinition.doesNotMean: charged matter must be absent; gapped charges may exist and be integrated out
allChargedDefectMatterGappedDefinition.finiteSizeQualification: gapped charge-one winding splits topological sectors by exponentially small terms, so exact pure-BF degeneracy is an infinite-volume/strict-IR statement

passedInputs: stable radial and massive-vector quadratic spectrum for the displayed parameters
exact first-order dualization to integer level three
orbifold parity removes the unwanted zero modes and its BF boundary variation
the sourced Maxwell-reader boundary equation is explicitly stated
a positive-mass bosonic charge-one reader can coexist without an anomaly or condensate
openInputs: dynamical origin of the S1/Z2 reflection defect or equivalent folding
selection of one physical orientation rather than its CP conjugate
derivation and localization of the charge-one reader from S_v1
audit of every Standard-Model and boundary charged mode
physical compact two-cycle and scale hierarchy
